hits.snippet: Tamarind Ledger helps market traders in Lagos keep track of what they are owed and collect it by transfer.

pages.title: Tamarind Ledger
pages.text: Tamarind Ledger. Market traders keep their credit book in a notebook. Tamarind Ledger keeps it for them, sends WhatsApp reminders to customers who owe, and lets them pay by transfer. Based in Lagos, Nigeria.
